genius.notes: Historical 2026-08-14 review: applicability non-payment-token; authorization, issuer pathway, foreign exception and DASP posture not-applicable. Prior note: No GENIUS authorization was assessed because the reviewed product description makes pUSD platform collateral, not a payment stablecoin. Re-check if pUSD is later externally listed or marketed for general payments, and confirm the token issuer's legal entity. D17 review on 2026-10-01 withdraws that categorical exclusion pending qualified token-specific legal analysis of holder repayment obligations and any US securities or deposit exclusion. Authorization and pathway are separately unknown; no approval or negative authorization census is asserted. Platform-only use and lack of external listing are product facts, not statutory exclusions. The enforcement field remains the historical 2026-08-14 posture and was not refreshed in this applicability review. Re-review on publication of governing holder terms or qualified regulator/legal analysis, otherwise by 2027-01-01. October 7 2026 re-verification: unclear applicability is retained, but authorization unknown is replaced with a dated, bounded no-public-authorization-found review. Current pUSD docs show ERC-20 transferability, USDC.e wrap/unwrap contract calls and admin pause gates, while the April 28 exchange-upgrade help disclosure describes native USDC backing/settlement. This terminology mismatch is not resolved by assuming native and bridged USDC are legally identical. Neither document establishes a token-specific issuer obligation to repay national-currency monetary value or a qualified securities/deposit exclusion. Coinbase/Circle permissions and prediction-market operator permissions do not automatically authorize this token. Geographic restrictions are selective, explicitly allowing Bulgaria, so neither all-EU exclusion nor blanket closed-loop exemption is asserted. Polymarket.com/tos reopened but reader exposed page shell/US popup rather than binding clauses; no exact token legal issuer or domicile is guessed. No independent reserve attestation or token-specific GENIUS approval was established. General DASP posture is pre-effective, separate from the platform's current country restrictions and sanctions. Enforcement negative is token-specific and does not erase platform/affiliate regulatory history. Independent verification October 7 2026 confirms the current authorization conclusion is no-public-authorization-found, superseding the historical October 1 unknown status, while applicability remains unclear and pathway unknown. The live Terms route returned a content shell in both static and browser reads; Adventure One QSS Inc. appears in the international platform footer but is not established as the token issuer. The CFTC January 3 2022 Blockratize order concerns earlier event-contract platform conduct and does not establish a pUSD GENIUS enforcement action. No broader assertion of an enforcement-free Polymarket corporate history is made.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified issuer authorization, official GENIUS application or foreign registration was located for Polymarket USD/pUSD and an identified pUSD issuer in the stated materials and exact-token searches. This is a bounded public-source review, not proof of legal non-compliance or an assertion that no nonpublic application exists. The SCRC IFR is procedural and legacy trust/MTL permissions are not GENIUS issuer qualification. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located; platform or affiliate regulatory history is not treated as token enforcement. The exact legal token issuer remains unresolved, limiting entity-level completeness; the negative conclusion covers the stated token names and opened public materials only.
